pose.selection: predeclare synthetic pose metric (ADD-S with invalid PnP failures) on independent complete rollouts, tie earlier; center/corner/grid diagnostics reported separately

pose.preflight: ordinary eval, confidence-only cell selection, no GT crop/mask/box, independently held-out synthetic localization/PnP/geometry and resume

actual batch, optimizer, update budget, schedule, validation/selection and init/sample stream hashes
